subtitle: Lesson 24 · Capstone

code:
Scaling signal: concurrent requests/instance
  target: 10 concurrent per instance

< 10 across the fleet  -> stay put
> 10 sustained          -> add an instance
caption: A more direct "is this instance keeping up" than CPU percent -- and it generalizes to a future GPU model.

code:
min_instances: 1
  -> cold start is 1-2s on CPU, tolerable here

max_instances: 5
  -> hard cost ceiling, this is a portfolio project

target_concurrency: 10
  -> measured where p95 latency passed 500ms
caption: Not framework defaults left untouched -- every number ties back to a reason.

eyebrow: A health check that actually checks
code:
GET /health
  -> loads a tiny test sentence through the model
  -> 200 OK only if the model actually returns
     a result, not just "the process is running"
caption: A check that only confirms the process is alive would pass even with a broken model load.
